title: Lazy Dungeon Master
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Keima, a young man who only wants to sleep, is pulled into a fantasy world and made master of a dungeon whose core takes the form of a girl, Rokuko. To keep the dungeon alive he runs it with tricks and incentives, including dealing with bandits, while a slave girl he acquires serves him (Seven Seas blurb via AniList/MU; manga review on otakuauthor.com).
life_message: Cleverness and minimal effort can get you a comfortable life, even in a harsh world where people are owned.

content.note: Bandits, Holy Knights and monster fights; a minion sacrifices himself (manga review).

folkways.japan: A typical Japanese web-novel isekai built on game systems and the 'lazy protagonist' trope, described as genre context.

delivery.evidence: Reviews describe a comic, matter-of-fact tone with no lessons drawn (otakuauthor manga review; LN review).
delivery.note: The story does not argue for a view; reviewers note it leaves slavery and abuse unexamined.

winners_losers: Keima and his dungeon prosper by cunning; slaves and bandits' captives are treated as background, and no worldview challenging slavery gets voice.
